Use haversine: a = sin²(Δlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin²(Δlon/2). sin(Δlat/2)=sin(0.121)=0.1207, squared=0.0146. cos(lat1)=cos(0.417)=0.914, cos(lat2)=cos(0.659)=0.790. sin(Δlon/2)=sin(-2.132)= -0.845, squared=0.714.
